title: TokenInsights: a new web direction
question: Usage first. Sky + pink throughout. Compare the layouts, choose a direction, or ask for a fresh set.

options.label: Usage Atlas
options.thesis: One continuous view of your usage, with the chart as the main event.
materials: Sky chart ink and pink totals
options.viewport: A slim view index anchors a wide chart; its total and component legend sit beside it, with a precise results table below.
options.risk: Its open layout needs careful small-screen reflow to keep filters close.

raised.raise: Align chart scales, metric labels, and table columns to a disciplined shared grid.
Keep selected scope visible and preserve navigation state across every view.
Make loading, updating, and ready states unmistakable without decorative delay.
Give headings, totals, and controls distinct typographic roles at every size.
Let the current usage measure establish the first read with decisive scale.

options.label: Signal Studio
options.thesis: A playful measurement workspace with controls arranged around the signal.
options.viewport: A horizontal view bar sits above an integrated metric strip and wide plot, with filters in a right-hand control rail.
options.risk: Familiar to developer-tool users; more recognisable dashboard structure than Atlas.

options.label: Soft Focus
options.thesis: A spacious, approachable usage overview with rounded surfaces and easy controls.
options.viewport: One generous usage panel leads to component rows and a comparison panel; a persistent bottom bar carries the six views.
options.risk: Lower density means more scrolling on wide analytics and tables.
options.case: Matches Atlas for at-a-glance clarity; less familiar to developers working through many filters.

options.label: Reference edition
options.thesis: A measured spread places usage and its definitions around a central key rail.
options.viewport: Twin columns, a sky key rail, pink total markers, generous annotation margins.
options.risk: Its small book-like measures make wide analytics harder to scan.
options.case: Developers identify less with typeset editions; the central rail splits the primary usage read.
options.kept: Align chart scales, metric labels, and table columns to a disciplined shared grid.

options.label: Linked usage cards
options.thesis: Each usage view becomes a deep-linked card in a browsable stack.
options.viewport: A total card, visible previous/next navigation, and sky buttons on pink-edged sheets.
options.risk: Card-by-card navigation can hide useful comparisons.
options.case: Card browsing is less familiar for analytics; separate cards obscure the overall usage pattern.
options.kept: Keep selected scope visible and preserve navigation state across every view.

options.label: Exposure bench
options.thesis: Usage moves through clear stages from summary to filtered detail.
options.viewport: A sky-washed overview station, pink readout, then chart and table stations.
options.risk: Sequential stations slow down direct comparison.
options.case: The developer audience has little attachment to darkroom rituals; a fixed sequence impedes flexible filters.
options.kept: Make loading, updating, and ready states unmistakable without decorative delay.

options.label: Label system
options.thesis: Bold label plates turn usage dimensions into immediate wayfinding.
options.viewport: Large navy tab labels, sky selection plates, pink total labels, squared result regions.
options.risk: Oversized labels and stripes can crowd out data.
options.case: Fashion labelling has weaker audience relevance; quotation and warning-like marks add reading noise.
options.kept: Give headings, totals, and controls distinct typographic roles at every size.

options.label: Living numerals
options.thesis: A typographic field lets the selected usage measure dominate the canvas.
options.viewport: Large stable numbers lead to a sky chart, with pink marking the active measure.
options.risk: Expressive transitions can distract from precise comparison.
options.case: Typographic spectacle offers less identification and clarity than stable measurement graphics.
options.kept: Let the current usage measure establish the first read with decisive scale.

canonCard.label: Classic analytics
canonCard.thesis: The familiar analytics layout, carefully rebuilt in sky + pink.
canonCard.viewport: Top tabs and filters, five summary cards, chart, then table.
canonCard.risk: Polished but structurally close to the current UI.
